Legion
"We Are Legion!"

Legion Commander

Commander: Ethan Morrac
Description: The Commander gives orders to the Squad leaders when doing Operations. However he is not afraid to get his hands dirty and jump into fire fights.

Legion Squads

[Assault] (3 Members)

Description: The iron fist of Legion, these are the men who are heavily armed and armored. If a room needs clearing or criminals need taking down these guys are men for the job. This squad wears Duty armor.

Squad Leader: Alexander Morgan

Squad Member:

David Slowsky
Snake Logan


[Recon] (3 Members)

Description: The Recon squad are the men who scout out for the Assault team, their primary job is surveillance however when the Assault team moves in they are also Legion's medics. These men are Sniper and Medical Specialists. This squad wears Nimble Uniforms.

Squad Leader: Heinreich 'Fallen' Keller

Squad Members:

Joseph 'Brains' McKenzie
Vince Marko
